data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Aisha, meaning ‘the living one’ or ‘the one who is alive.’ In Islamic history, Ayeesha bint Abu Bakr is known as the mother of the believers and the wife of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Ayeesha carries the meaning “The Living One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayeesha usually hope their child will grow to embody the living one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
